'''2007 Utah State Championship James Lewis LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[James Lewis]] at [[2007 Utah State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
